partes.p: Show that $\displaystyle\iint_{R} \text{curl}\,\vec{F} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{n}}\,dS = 0$ for any finite portion $R$ of the unit sphere $x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = 1$ (take the normal vector $\hat{\mathbf{n}}$ pointing outward).
Show that $\displaystyle\oint_{C} \vec{F} \cdot d\vec{r} = 0$ for any simple closed curve $C$ on the unit sphere $x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = 1$.
